builds.name: Honey Badger
builds.description: Designed to fight almost any opposition, survive an ambush, and complete a wide variety of missions for the faction. Honey Badger is built as one of the fleet's most formidable all-around forces.

builds.name: Fire Storm
builds.description: A close-range brawler based on the popular Frag-Conda concept, with most of its firepower centered on frag cannons. Fire Storm has proven itself relentless in a wide variety of combat situations.

builds.name: Nightshade
builds.description: As sturdy as Alliance Challengers come. Nightshade can dish out heavy hits while taking punishment in return, making it one of the fleet's primary medium-class ships for combat engagements.
